patterns.note: The hero section employs a highly asymmetrical layout, featuring an extremely large, condensed text title on the left spanning most of the width, balanced by a tall, pixelated black-and-white image on the right.

The site uses a dramatic contrast in typography, pairing massive, condensed display fonts for primary headings and section titles with a much smaller, monospaced font for body text, metadata, and navigation links, creating a zine-like or editorial aesthetic.
A high-contrast, monochromatic color scheme dominates, primarily using dark charcoal backgrounds with stark white text and black accents, giving a stark, almost brutalist feel.
A thin, uppercase text banner at the very top of the page remains fixed in place as the user scrolls, providing a persistent message while the rest of the content scrolls underneath it.

Section headers are rendered as large, graphic text elements that often span the full content width, sometimes with a subtle background texture or border, making them feel like distinct visual breaks rather than simple titles.

technique_notes: The site's motion system features a fixed top banner that maintains its position at the top of the viewport, ensuring a key message is always visible regardless of scroll depth. Other content scrolls naturally beneath this fixed element.

Typography is used as a primary design element, with extremely large, condensed display fonts for titles and section headers that command attention, contrasted sharply with small, monospaced body text for readability and a distinct editorial tone.

Visuals are integrated as high-contrast, often pixelated or distressed black-and-white images that are part of the content flow, rather than decorative backgrounds, reinforcing the site's raw, editorial aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed display headings (e.g., 'TRUE TERRORS' is ~10x body text height) paired with small, monospaced body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, with large negative space around the main title and image, transitioning to a balanced density for content blocks and a dense, multi-column footer.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of typography, featuring massive, condensed display fonts that dominate the page and create a powerful, editorial impact. This is combined with a high-contrast, monochromatic palette and pixelated imagery, giving it the feel of a highly stylized digital zine or newspaper rather than a typical modern website.
